reasoning: Both audits correctly identified the PKGBUILD as safe with verified sources and standard installation logic. No executable scripts/hooks exist in the package, and all reviewed files were configuration files from the upstream binary bundle with no security impact.
coverage_issues: qwen failed to review any files beyond PKGBUILD despite available configuration files
deepseek wasted resources auditing low-priority Java config files instead of focusing on packaging artifacts
learnings: Improve file prioritization: Models should focus exclusively on packaging artifacts (PKGBUILD, .install hooks) rather than upstream binary content
Enforce stricter file selection: Prevent auditing of vendor-provided runtime/config files unless referenced in packaging functions
Handle LLM failures better: When file selection fails, default to critical files only (PKGBUILD/hooks) instead of arbitrary fallbacks
Clarify scope: Emphasize in prompts that only files executed during makepkg/install are security-relevant
